review_candidates.title: BO CS Core Engineer
review_candidates.description_excerpt: The role covers CS, IMS, and SVC solutions , with responsibilities and technical depth aligned to the candidates experience level. Experience Levels 2–5 Years Responsibilities & Technical Requirements Core Network Knowledge Understand the basic structure of mobile communication networks Knowledge of CS / SVC solutions or IMS / SBC services with basic configuration capabilities Signaling & Protocols Basic knowledge of SS7 , M3UA , signaling link configuration, and GT routing Familiarity with ISUP
review_candidates.requirements_excerpt: Experience Levels 2–5 Years Responsibilities & Technical Requirements Core Network Knowledge Understand the basic structure of mobile communication networks Knowledge of CS / SVC solutions or IMS / SBC services with basic configuration capabilities Signaling & Protocols Basic knowledge of SS7 , M3UA , signaling link configuration, and GT routing Familiarity with ISUP, BICC, SIP Understanding of mobility control protocols: BSSAP, RANAP, MAP, CAP General knowledge of SIP, SDP, DIAMETER, DNS, ENUM Mobility & Subscriber Concepts Understanding of authentication and encryption mechanisms Knowledge of LAI, LAC, cell, service area, paging, roaming, handover, STN-SR Ability to check subscriber profiles in HSS and understand basic subscriber parameters Operations & Support Perform L1 health checks and maintain operational scripts Monitor network performance, system logs, and capacity Enable traces
